instruction: Update the Value column in `cms_product_record.xlsx` on the Desktop with the current CMS details for `Joust Duffle Bag`. Use username `admin` and password `admin1234` to access the CMS admin site.
gt_steps: Open the self-hosted CMS admin site in Google Chrome.
Enter the username `admin`.
Enter the password `admin1234`.
Sign in to the CMS admin site.
Open the product catalog without editing any product data.
Find the product `Joust Duffle Bag`.
Open `cms_product_record.xlsx` from the Desktop in LibreOffice Calc.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `ID` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Thumbnail` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the standard value `Joust Duffle Bag` for `Name`.
Enter the standard value `Simple Product` for `Type`.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Attribute Set` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the standard value `24-MB01` for `SKU`.
Enter the standard value `$34.00` for `Price`.
Enter the standard value `100.0000` for `Quantity`.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Salable Quantity` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Visibility` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Status` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Websites` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Last Updated At` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Enter the displayed CMS value for `Action` in the spreadsheet Value column.
Save `cms_product_record.xlsx`.

result.command: python -c "from openpyxl import load_workbook; from pathlib import Path; p=Path.home()/'Desktop'/'cms_product_record.xlsx'; wb=load_workbook(p, data_only=True); ws=wb.active; print('\n'.join(f'{ws.cell(r,1).value}: {ws.cell(r,2).value}' for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1) if ws.cell(r,2).value is not None and str(ws.cell(r,2).value).strip() != ''))"
